name: Amanita muscaria
summary: Amanita muscaria is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: Muscimol has an atypical mechanism of action. Unlike classical psychedelics (which are 5-HT2A agonists) and classical dissociatives (which are NMDA receptor antagonists), muscimol is a potent GABAA agonist, meaning it activates the receptor for GABA, the brain's principle inhibitory neurotransmitter. As an agonist, muscimol binds to the same site on the GABAA receptor as GABA itself.

uses.text: Amanita muscaria has been used as an intoxicant and entheogen by the peoples of Siberia, and has a religious significance in these cultures. In eastern Siberia, A. muscaria was used by both shamans and laypeople alike, and was used recreationally as well as religiously.

zhOther: 毒蠅鵝膏菌, 毒蠅鵝膏, 蛤蟆菌, 蛤蟆蕈
summaryZh: 毒蠅傘（學名：Amanita muscaria），俗稱毒蠅鵝膏菌、蠅傘菌（英語：fly agaric, fly amanita），是鵝膏菌屬的一種擔子菌。這種大型蘑菇特徵為白色的菌鰓、白色斑點，外觀通常為紅色。

sideEffects.en: It commonly causes nausea, vomiting, dizziness, sweating, muscle twitching, confusion and deep sleep with vivid dreams. Larger amounts can cause delirium, seizures and loss of consciousness. It is easily confused with deadly Amanita species such as the death cap, which destroy the liver.
sideEffects.zh: 它常造成噁心、嘔吐、頭暈、出汗、肌肉抽動、混亂，以及伴隨鮮明夢境的深眠。較大量可能引起譫妄、癲癇發作與意識喪失。它很容易與毒鵝膏等致命的鵝膏菌混淆，後者會摧毀肝臟。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它常造成恶心、呕吐、头晕、出汗、肌肉抽动、混乱，以及伴随鲜明梦境的深眠。较大量可能引起谵妄、癫痫发作与意识丧失。它很容易与毒鹅膏等致命的鹅膏菌混淆，后者会摧毁肝脏。

fact.en: Its name comes from its old use as a flykiller, soaked in milk on a windowsill. The red cap with white flecks is the mushroom of fairytale illustrations, and it was used by Siberian peoples as an intoxicant long before its chemistry was understood.
fact.zh: 毒蠅傘的名稱來自它過去被泡在牛奶中放在窗台殺蒼蠅的用途。帶白斑的紅色菇傘就是童話插畫中的那朵蘑菇，早在它的化學成分被了解之前，西伯利亞民族就已將它用作致醉物。
fact.zhHans: 毒蝇伞的名称来自它过去被泡在牛奶中放在窗台杀苍蝇的用途。带白斑的红色菇伞就是童话插画中的那朵蘑菇，早在它的化学成分被了解之前，西伯利亚民族就已将它用作致醉物。
